name: Guides and Explanations
role: Explanation, guides and non-code templates (the main feature of the repository).

name: Adopter Testimonials
role: Adopters as short examples and testimonials.

name: Records of This Repository
role: The records (CSV) and generated pages of every intent: the top intent in esoi/ and each container with the solutions beside their code.

name: Project Files
role: Files at the repository root: readme, configuration, contributing, licence.

name: GitHub Wiki Generator
role: A thin wrapper that generates this repository's GitHub wiki from docs/ through esoi docs wiki.

name: Docs Standard
role: Checking the four-category docs standard and generating a wiki from docs/, so the docs stay the one source.

name: Public Skill
role: The generated public copy of the author's skill, its plugin manifest and the copy bundled in the package.

name: Records Core
role: Loading the configuration and the CSV records, and checking the intent records against the template.

name: Template Reader
role: Reading the intent template from its source and keeping the parsed copy.

name: Declarative Case Checks
role: The declarative check that case-driven evaluations share.

name: Balanced Score
role: Folding accuracy, cost and time of a metric run into one score with written weights and budgets.

name: Template Documents
role: Generating the non-code templates and excerpts from the template source.

name: Rule Interface
role: The rule interface: what a rule group is, what a rule sees, and the cache of module facts the rules share.

name: Placement and Layering Rules
role: The placement and layering rules.

name: Registry Rules
role: The rules about the registry's own shape and the selection table.

name: Measurement Rules
role: The rules about measurement, provenance and discriminating cases.

name: Generated File Rules
role: The rules about generated files, the tracker and the records.

name: Check Runner
role: Running every rule over a repository and reporting problems.

name: Run Harness
role: Running one implementation over a component's cases and recording the result.

name: Solution Diagram Drawer
role: Drawing each intent's solution diagram (Mermaid) from the solutions' outputs and the implementations' dependencies, and listing the diagrams out of date.

name: Run Guards
role: Refusing an esoi run that cannot inform a decision: a perfect arm already caps it, a public result already exists, or the cases that failed last have not been rerun to a pass.

name: Run Log
role: Saving every run case by case, even a stopped one, and reading it back to rerun only the failing cases and to reuse cases an earlier stage already ran.

name: Model Call Cassette
role: Recording model calls in a plain JSONL cassette and replaying a call it already holds without calling the model, with replayed usage kept apart from real spend.

name: Parent Selection Follower
role: Comparing a parent repository's current selections with this repository's lock and overrides and judging each change on this repository's own metric, as advice.

name: Review Tracker Builder
role: Building the review tracker tabs and syncing them with a sheet.

name: Integration Registry Check
role: Checking a consuming repository's integration registry.

name: Public Hygiene Scan
role: Scanning a public repository for secrets and private data.

name: Example Repository Scaffold
role: Writing the passing example repository that the init command produces.

name: Command Line
role: The esoi command, a thin call into the module that owns each behaviour.

name: Python Tests
role: Offline tests that pin each module.

name: Structure Check Cases
role: Mutation cases for the whole check.

name: File Ownership Cases
role: Mutation cases for placement and layering.

name: Intent Record Cases
role: Mutation cases for the intent records.

name: Template Sync Cases
role: Cases for reading the template.

name: Harness Cases
role: Cases for the harness.

name: Leaderboard Cases
role: Cases for the leaderboard.

name: Review Tracker Cases
role: Cases for the tracker.

name: Consumer Check Cases
role: Mutation cases for the consumer check.

name: Stale Result Cases
role: Cases for telling a stale result from a current one.

name: Shared Evaluation Fixtures
role: Fixtures shared by the evaluations, the results log and the per-case log.

name: Python Packaging
role: Packaging, the implementation's readme and its reference documents.

name: Continuous Integration Workflow
role: The continuous integration workflow.

name: Skill Distribution
role: Generating, checking and installing the public copy of the author's skill.

name: Skill Sync Cases
role: Cases for the sync, the drift check, leak detection and install.

name: Intent Tree
role: Finding the intent folders of a repository and reading their records as one tree.

name: Parsed Source
role: Parsing each Python file once and walking each tree once per run for every reader of source.

name: Intent Migration
role: Moving a legacy two-level repository to the intent layout without inventing a sub-intent.

name: Intent Rules
role: The rules about intents as containers: the sub-intent link, the opportunity and ids across the tree.

name: Local Index
role: The local ESOI index: projects, their relations and where to look.

name: Local Index Cases
role: Lookup cases over a small world of projects, the live index and the arms it is compared with.

name: Reply Grader
role: Grading an AI agent's reply against a behaviour case: the pattern check, the judge prompt and verdict, and a command provider.

name: Behaviour Cases
role: Cases, recorded replies and the arms for whether an agent acts by the principles.

name: Judge Agreement Cases
role: Labelled replies and the arms for how far a judge agrees with them.

name: Code Declaration Reader
role: Reading the declarations in the code, the drift rule S30 and the sync of the records.

name: Technology Admission
role: Taking a newly found technology into the structure as an implementation with no arm yet, and recording a justified change to the specification.

name: New Solution Command
role: Creating a whole solution with one command.

name: README Renderer
role: The README of each intent folder, generated from its records.

name: Winner Promotion
role: Switching the selected implementation to the winner of the solution's own metric, or proposing it.

name: Specify from the Code Cases
role: Cases for reading declarations, syncing the records and creating a solution.

name: Readable Records Cases
role: Cases for the generated README of an intent folder.

name: Glanceable README Cases
role: Cases for the layouts of the README of an intent folder: one case per intent folder, scored by model-free glance checks.

name: Navigable Records Cases
role: Cases for the layouts of a repository's records: one case per solution, scored by model-free navigation checks.

name: Promotion Cases
role: Cases for promoting the winner of a solution's metric.

name: Specification Index
role: The spec index solution's interface and implementations.

name: Specification Index Cases
role: Cases and scorer for spec-index.

name: Cascade Rules
role: The rules about cascading conditionals: the list can be read (S32) and the selection follows the cascade (S33).

name: Hierarchy Rule
role: Rule S35: a child that overrides its parent's default cites a record of its own as the reason.

name: Version Stamp
role: The stamp of the skill and template the library follows, the template version, and recording it in a repository.

name: Version Rule
role: The rule S34: the template version a repository records is the one the library carries.

name: Metric Record Keeper
role: Finding the slice of the specification a piece of work serves, reading its metric before and after with bounded meters, and keeping the rows in a ledger.

name: Metric Record Cases
role: Cases for the slice, milestone, meter reading, result, reconcile and iteration of a piece of work's metric record.

name: Circumstance Slicing
role: Reading the circumstances that slice a run's results by a condition on cases or runs, and the variant names (base@key=value) that arms carry.

name: Spec Search
role: The spec search solution's interface and implementations.

name: Spec Search Cases
role: Cases and scorer for spec-search.

name: Public Evidence Cases
role: Cases for grading evidence and for ranking candidates on one shared basis.

name: Choice Statistics
role: Wilson interval, exact paired McNemar test and Holm correction for choosing by metric.

name: Evidence Table
role: Markdown table of every evaluated solution's arms with intervals, verdicts and public evidence, written between markers.

name: One-Line Entry
role: One line for any solution or intent: run(id, input) through the declared interface, and its offline check.

name: Standards Navigation
role: Showing an author only the standards whose risk tags and paths match the file in hand, checking a commit against them on the lines it adds, and measuring on past commits whether the standards shown for a task were the ones its work needed.

name: Records Beside the Code
role: Records kept beside the code: where each record belongs, the moves that put it there or back, and the advisory rule S40.

name: Stale Result Rules
role: Which changed files make a recorded result stale: the whole repository, the files the arm's component owns, or the files its module imports; and the attestations that a change to the arm did not move what its result measures.

name: Staleness Precision Cases
role: A fixture of commits to a small repository, the hand-written verdict per component and the three rules.

name: One-Criterion Rules
role: The advisory rules about a cascade running one criterion: stages that score several components (S41), separate leaderboards for one solution (S42), a selected baseline (S43) and balance weights changed after scoring (S44).

name: Metric Foundation
role: A consumer's metric building on the metric of the library it depends on: reusing the foundation's recorded per-case results when the digests match, running the foundation's own scorer when they do not, composing one number at stated shares, and inheriting its cascade gates.

name: Source Access
role: Metering, pricing and bounding what a request reads from source systems (records, bytes, calls, scopes, full scans) as cost and as gates a consumer may only tighten.

name: Foundation Rule
role: The rule about a metric building on a foundation: a readable declaration, inherited stages that exist, and gates no looser than the foundation's (S47).

name: Wording Rules
role: The advisory rules S51 and S52: a problem says what is true, and an ideal says the state that is wanted, not a solution.

name: Selection Table Resolver
role: Resolving an implementation of a solution from a selection table.

name: Selection Cases
role: Cases for resolving a selection.

name: Declarations and Cascade
role: Declarations in code and the cascade that picks the implementation a call runs.

name: Dependency-Ordered Assembler
role: Building the parts of a program by validated name in dependency order, with the cascade that picks each implementation and a frozen result.

name: Hierarchical Defaults
role: Hierarchical defaults as plain data: the layers of one solution's cascade, conditional entries and the recorded reasons a child differs from its parent.

name: Assembly Cases
role: Cases for assembling by name: hostile names and snapshots, shadowing, cycles, unmet needs, concurrent assembles and the examples in the docs.

name: Selection Lock
role: Pinning the selected implementations in a lock file, showing what a newer release would change and moving the lock on the consumer's schedule.

name: Interface of The Standard
role: The Protocol declared with @solution for The Standard and its selected arm.

role: The Protocol declared with @solution for The ESOI Steps and its selected arm.

role: The Protocol declared with @solution for Skill Distribution and its selected arm.

role: The Protocol declared with @solution for Readable Records and its selected arm.

role: The Protocol declared with @solution for Intent Registry and its selected arm.

role: The Protocol declared with @solution for Template Sync and its selected arm.

role: The Protocol declared with @solution for Specify from the Code and its selected arm.

name: Interface of Ownership Map
role: The Protocol declared with @solution for Ownership Map and its selected arm.

name: Interface of Structure Check
role: The Protocol declared with @solution for Structure Check and its selected arm.

name: Interface of Structure Budget
role: The Protocol declared with @solution for Structure Budget and its selected arm.

name: Interface of Measurement Harness
role: The Protocol declared with @solution for Measurement Harness and its selected arm.

name: Interface of Discriminating Cases
role: The Protocol declared with @solution for Discriminating Cases and its selected arm.

name: Interface of When Metrics Are Run
role: The Protocol declared with @solution for When Metrics Are Run and its selected arm.

name: Interface of Implementation Leaderboard
role: The Protocol declared with @solution for Implementation Leaderboard and its selected arm.

name: Interface of Promote the Winner
role: The Protocol declared with @solution for Promote the Winner and its selected arm.

name: Interface of Keep a Metric Record
role: The Protocol declared with @solution for Keep a Metric Record and its selected arm.

name: Interface of Implementation Selection
role: The Protocol declared with @solution for Implementation Selection and its selected arm.

name: Interface of Assemble Parts by Name
role: The Protocol declared with @solution for Assemble Parts by Name and its selected arm.

name: Interface of Consumer Check
role: The Protocol declared with @solution for Consumer Check and its selected arm.

name: Flow of Understanding
role: The interface of Understanding and its composition arm: the order in which it calls its parts.

name: Flow of Structure
role: The interface of Structure and its composition arm: the order in which it calls its parts.

name: Flow of Optimization
role: The interface of Optimization and its composition arm: the order in which it calls its parts.

name: Flow of Runtime
role: The interface of Runtime and its composition arm: the order in which it calls its parts.

name: Flow of Apply ESOI to a Project
role: The root's interface and its two arms: through the four containers, or documents only.

name: Package Folders
role: The empty __init__.py that makes each folder of the four containers a package.

name: Library Adoption Reader
role: Reading the adopts and specializes references of a repository and the library records they point at.

name: Interface of Library Adoption
role: The Protocol declared with @solution for Library Adoption and its selected arm.

name: Adoption Rule
role: The advisory rule S53: references resolve, an adopted row restates nothing, an own solution does not repeat a library solution, an arm declares the library solution id.

name: Adopted Solutions Section
role: The part of an intent's README that links adopted solutions to the library's page.

name: Structure Quality Scorer
role: Reading a project's code and records, scoring seven dimensions of how well it divides the work, mining co-change from git history, and folding them into one balanced number with the worst offenders named.

name: Interface of Structure Quality
role: The Protocol declared with @solution for Structure Quality and its three arms.

name: Structure Quality Rules
role: The advisory rules S54 to S59, one per dimension of Structure Quality: scope, size, coupling, reuse, public surface and behavior preserved.

name: Structure Quality Cases
role: Cases for the structure-quality scorer: small projects of generic incident shapes and clean exemplars, scored by what each arm flags and by comparison with the project cut into tiny files.
